purpose: Present a likely conclusion without claiming certainty.
keywords: 恐らく + clause; often だろう / はずだ
It will probably arrive by tomorrow morning.
The key is probably at reception.
This road is probably an old highway.
formation: 恐らく + clause; often だろう / はずだ
restrictions: Marks probability rather than directly verified fact.
mistake: Do not pair it with an unjustified claim of absolute certainty.
